args.subject: Request for Free Consultation
args.body:
Hello,

I recently received your email about your event organization services, and I would like to take you up on the offer of a free consultation.

Could you please let me know a time that works for you? I'm happy to share more details about the event I'm planning in advance so that we can make the most of the consultation.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
